question: Which region generated the highest revenue?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    Region, 
    ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS Total_Revenue, 
    ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS Total_Profit,
    COUNT(Order_ID) AS Total_Orders,
    ROUND(AVG(Discount) * 100, 1) AS Avg_Discount_Pct
FROM sales_transactions
GROUP BY Region
ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC;

question: Show monthly sales trends.
sql_query:
SELECT 
    STRFTIME(TRY_CAST(Order_Date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS Month,
    ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS Monthly_Revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS Monthly_Profit,
    COUNT(Order_ID) AS Order_Volume
FROM sales_transactions
WHERE Order_Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Month
ORDER BY Month ASC;

question: Which products are underperforming?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.Product_Name, s.Product_ID) AS Product,
    COUNT(s.Order_ID) AS Total_Units_Sold,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Revenue), 2) AS Total_Revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Profit), 2) AS Total_Profit,
    ROUND((SUM(s.Profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.Revenue), 0)) * 100, 1) AS Profit_Margin_Pct
FROM sales_transactions s
LEFT JOIN products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
GROUP BY Product
HAVING SUM(s.Profit) < 1000 OR (SUM(s.Profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.Revenue), 0)) < 0.1
ORDER BY Profit_Margin_Pct ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: What are the top five customers?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.Customer_Name, s.Customer_ID) AS Customer, c.Segment,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Revenue), 2) AS Total_Spent,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Profit), 2) AS Total_Profit_Contribution,
    COUNT(s.Order_ID) AS Order_Count
FROM sales_transactions s
LEFT JOIN customers c ON s.Customer_ID = c.Customer_ID
GROUP BY Customer, c.Segment
ORDER BY Total_Spent DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Which products are underperforming?
sql_query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.Product_Name, s.Product_ID) AS Product,
    COUNT(s.Order_ID) AS Total_Units_Sold,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Revenue), 2) AS Total_Revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(s.Profit), 2) AS Total_Profit,
    ROUND((SUM(s.Profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.Revenue), 0)) * 100, 1) AS Profit_Margin_Pct
FROM sales_transactions s
LEFT JOIN products p ON s.Product_ID = p.Product_ID
GROUP BY Product
HAVING SUM(s.Profit) < 1000 OR (SUM(s.Profit) / NULLIF(SUM(s.Revenue), 0)) < 0.1
ORDER BY Profit_Margin_Pct ASC
LIMIT 10;
